description:
ChainRegistry.context() (contracts/chain-registry/ChainRegistry.sol#265-279) uses msg.value but is not reachable from any payable function
	Non-payable entry points that can reach this function:
	- ChainRegistry.activate(string,uint64) (contracts/chain-registry/ChainRegistry.sol#171-173)
	- ChainRegistry.activeGrants(string) (contracts/chain-registry/ChainRegistry.sol#216-220)
	- ChainRegistry.addKey(string,uint64,IChainRegistry.KeyInput) (contracts/chain-registry/ChainRegistry.sol#177-179)
	- ChainRegistry.authorizeOperator(string,uint64,address,string) (contracts/chain-registry/ChainRegistry.sol#190-197)
	- ChainRegistry.commitClaim(bytes32) (contracts/chain-registry/ChainRegistry.sol#151-160)
	- ChainRegistry.deactivate(string,uint64) (contracts/chain-registry/ChainRegistry.sol#174-176)
	- ChainRegistry.historyItem(string,uint64) (contracts/chain-registry/ChainRegistry.sol#221-225)
	- ChainRegistry.record(string) (contracts/chain-registry/ChainRegistry.sol#211-215)
	- ChainRegistry.registryId() (contracts/chain-registry/ChainRegistry.sol#206-210)
	- ChainRegistry.revealClaim(string,address,IChainRegistry.KeyInput[],IChainRegistry.ServiceInput[],bytes32) (contracts/chain-registry/ChainRegistry.sol#162-170)
	- ChainRegistry.revokeKey(string,uint64,string) (contracts/chain-registry/ChainRegistry.sol#180-182)
	- ChainRegistry.revokeOperator(string,uint64,address,string) (contracts/chain-registry/ChainRegistry.sol#198-205)
	- ChainRegistry.updateServices(string,uint64,IChainRegistry.ServiceInput[]) (contracts/chain-registry/ChainRegistry.sol#183-189)

sage_review.classification: Intentional redundant rejection invariant, not an ETH fee/payment precondition
sage_review.reason: All thirteen public methods are nonpayable or view, context is private, the only payable fallback unconditionally reverts and never calls context. The protocol accepts no ETH value. Existing compiler-native nonpayable rejection is permitted. No broad detector/path/severity exclusion is proposed.
sage_review.revisit: Any Core source/ABI/payable entry/reachable context change invalidates this justification and requires a new exact review
sage_review.presentation: Pinned analyzer caller list sorted by canonical_name before unchanged upstream _build_info; exact one reviewed finding only
